## locationUtils variable

Location utilities that can be mocked in tests. These functions wrap location calls to avoid JSDOM 23+ restrictions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
locationUtils: {
    assign(url: string): void;
    reload(): void;
    getSearch(): string;
    getPathname(): string;
    getLocation(): string;
    getOrigin(): string;
}
```
